name: Yugami no Kuni no Alice
source:
I awoke at school one day when a strange person calling himself the "Cheshire Cat" said to me so...
"Now, Our Alice, let's chase the White Rabbit."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003550/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
有一天，我在学校醒来，一个自称“柴郡猫”的陌生人对我说了这样的话……
“现在，我们的爱丽丝，我们去追白兔吧。”

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2003550/]Steam[/url]]
